chmmc-cmm-2025-bee-qual-03.title: Solution
chmmc-cmm-2025-bee-qual-03.body:
Let $I$ be the integral. Substituting $x\to-x$ gives $I=\int_{-3}^3\frac{x^4}{1+e^{x}}dx$. Adding: $2I=\int_{-3}^3x^4\left(\frac1{1+e^{-x}}+\frac1{1+e^{x}}\right)dx=\int_{-3}^3x^4dx=\frac{2\cdot3^5}5$, so $I=\frac{243}5$.

**Answer: $\frac{243}5$**

chmmc-cmm-2025-bee-qual-04.title: Solution
chmmc-cmm-2025-bee-qual-04.body:
Put $x=e^u$: $\int_{-\infty}^0e^u(\sin u+\cos u)\,du$. Since $\frac{d}{du}\big(e^u\sin u\big)=e^u(\sin u+\cos u)$, the integral is $\big[e^u\sin u\big]_{-\infty}^0=0$.

**Answer: 0**

chmmc-cmm-2025-bee-qual-05.title: Solution
chmmc-cmm-2025-bee-qual-05.body:
The integrand is odd ($\cos$ even, $\arctan$ odd), so over the symmetric interval the contributions cancel: $0$. (Near $0$ the integrand behaves like $1/x$, so the integral is understood as a symmetric/principal-value integral.)

**Answer: 0**

chmmc-cmm-2025-bee-qual-06.title: Solution
chmmc-cmm-2025-bee-qual-06.body:
$1+\cos x=2\cos^2\frac x2$ and $\cos\frac x2\ge0$ on $[\frac\pi2,\pi]$, so $\sqrt{1+\cos x}=\sqrt2\cos\frac x2$ and the integral is $2\sqrt2\left[\sin\frac x2\right]_{\pi/2}^{\pi}=2\sqrt2\left(1-\frac{\sqrt2}2\right)=2\sqrt2-2$.

**Answer: $2\sqrt2-2$**

chmmc-cmm-2025-bee-qual-08.title: Solution
chmmc-cmm-2025-bee-qual-08.body:
On $[k,k+1)$ the integrand is $2025^{-k}$, so the integral is $\sum_{k\ge1}2025^{-k}=\frac{1/2025}{1-1/2025}=\frac1{2024}$.

**Answer: $\frac1{2024}$**

chmmc-cmm-2025-bee-qual-09.title: Solution
chmmc-cmm-2025-bee-qual-09.body:
Partial fractions: $\frac{2x+1}{(x-1)(x-2)(x-3)}=\frac{3/2}{x-1}-\frac5{x-2}+\frac{7/2}{x-3}$ (residues $\frac{3}{2},-5,\frac72$). Antiderivative $\frac32\ln(x-1)-5\ln(x-2)+\frac72\ln(x-3)$. At $5$: $\frac32\ln4-5\ln3+\frac72\ln2=\frac{13}2\ln2-5\ln3$; at $4$: $\frac32\ln3-5\ln2$. Difference: $\frac{23}{2}\ln2-\frac{13}{2}\ln3$.

**Answer: $\frac{23\ln2-13\ln3}2$**

chmmc-cmm-2025-bee-qual-11.title: Solution
chmmc-cmm-2025-bee-qual-11.body:
Since $\lfloor2x\rfloor$ is an integer, $\lfloor x+\lfloor2x\rfloor\rfloor=\lfloor x\rfloor+\lfloor2x\rfloor$. On $[0,\frac12)$ it is $0$; on $[\frac12,1)$ it is $0+1=1$; on $[1,\frac32)$ it is $1+2=3$. Integral $=\frac12\cdot1+\frac12\cdot3=2$.

**Answer: 2**

chmmc-cmm-2025-bee-qual-13.title: Solution
chmmc-cmm-2025-bee-qual-13.body:
$x^{-2/\ln x}=e^{-2\ln x/\ln x}=e^{-2}$, constant. So the integral is $(99-98)e^{-2}=e^{-2}$.

**Answer: $e^{-2}$**

chmmc-cmm-2025-bee-qual-14.title: Solution
chmmc-cmm-2025-bee-qual-14.body:
Complete the square: $-x^2+3x=-(x-\frac32)^2+\frac94$. Then $\int e^{-(x-3/2)^2}dx\cdot e^{9/4}=\sqrt\pi\,e^{9/4}$.

**Answer: $\sqrt\pi\,e^{9/4}$**
